entry_points.reason: Only called from metal_graph_encode_attention_session_batch (ds4.c) -- continuous/session batching is out of scope for this PRD. Single-stream TP decode applies RoPE via the already-real, non-TP-specific ds4_gpu_rope_tail_tensor instead.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_attention_noncausal_raw_batch_heads_tensor
entry_points.reason: DSpark-only (noncausal softmax over draft-window rows). DSpark speculative decoding in distributed/TP mode is out of scope for this PRD; silently ignored by the distributed coordinator per the PRD problem statement.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_attention_output_low_q4_K_slice_tensor
entry_points.reason: Only called when layer->attn_output_a->type == DS4_TENSOR_Q4_K. DeepSeek-V4-Flash's attn_output_a is Q8_0, so this branch is dead for the model this port targets.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_attention_output_low_q8_rows_exact_tensor
entry_points.reason: Session-batch only (metal_graph_encode_attn_post_session_batch, count>=2 concurrent decode items) -- continuous/session batching is out of scope for this PRD.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_attention_output_q4_K_batch_tensor
entry_points.reason: Same Q4_K attention-output-low branch as ds4_gpu_attention_output_low_q4_K_slice_tensor's batch variant -- dead for DeepSeek-V4-Flash's Q8_0 attn_output_a.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_device_cache_support_tensors
entry_points.reason: Errno-style '0 = success' contract; DSpark-only (engine_install_dspark_support_cache returns early when e->dspark is unset). Unreached by a plain TP session; DSpark in distributed mode is out of scope.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_device_cache_tensors
entry_points.reason: engine_install_per_device_caches runs for every multi-tier session (pipeline and TP alike). Always-succeed no-op is correctness-safe: every weight read falls back to a host-mapped/uncached read when no device range was cached, so this is a performance optimization not yet ported, not a correctness gap.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_dspark_markov_argmax_tensor
entry_points.reason: DSpark decode-time Markov-bias-plus-argmax fast path. DSpark speculative decoding in distributed/TP mode is out of scope for this PRD, so unreached by any TP session regardless of rank count.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_indexer_top1_value_tensor
entry_points.reason: Decode-only greedy-sampling shortcut (metal_graph_encode_output_head_split_top1) reached only when DS4_CUDA_GREEDY_SPLIT_TOP1 is explicitly set (default off) and no logits/top2 are needed. Off-by-default performance path, orthogonal to correctness of the default path.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_kv_fp8_store_raw_decode_rows_tensor
entry_points.reason: Only called from metal_graph_encode_qkv_session_batch (ds4.c) -- session batching is out of scope for this PRD. Single-stream decode stores KV via the already-real, non-TP-specific ds4_gpu_kv_fp8_store_raw_tensor instead.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_matmul_q8_0_kslice_hc_expand_add_tensor
entry_points.reason: fuse_tp_attn_out_hc / DS4_CUDA_TP_ATTN_OUT_HC_FUSE defaults off -- an optional decode-path fusion of the TP attention-output projection with the HC expand, not required for correctness.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_matmul_q8_0_kslice_tensor
entry_points.reason: Single-row (n_tokens==1) special case of the already-real ds4_gpu_matmul_q8_0_kslice_rows_tensor. Not reached from ds4.c directly (only caller is the dead matmul_quant_kslice_tensor fallback) but ported as a zero-risk two-line delegation, mirroring CUDA's own implementation, rather than left stubbed.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_matmul_q8_0_top1_tensor
entry_points.reason: Paired with ds4_gpu_indexer_top1_value_tensor as the decode-only greedy-sampling shortcut; off by default (DS4_CUDA_GREEDY_SPLIT_TOP1).

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_matmul_quant_kslice_tensor
entry_points.reason: Only called from metal_graph_matmul_dense_quant_kslice's non-Q8_0 output-head fallback, itself only reached when out_a/out_b aren't both Q8_0 -- dead for DeepSeek-V4-Flash's Q8_0 attn_output/output weights.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_moe_handoff_pack_tensor
entry_points.reason: Ported this slice: pure gather kernel (ffn_norm/selected/weights -> one contiguous buffer), no ownership/sharding decision. Reached when DS4_CUDA_TP_MOE_PACK=1 (default off) selects the packed-handoff MoE mode. Numeric-equivalence evidence: scaffold case moe_handoff_pack, exact byte-for-byte match (max_abs_err=0) against a host-packed reference on real hardware.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_register_model_map_no_copy
entry_points.reason: Delegates to the already-real ds4_gpu_set_model_map, which is already mmap-backed (no eager device copy). engine_install_per_device_caches calls it unconditionally for every multi-tier session, TP included.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_register_support_map
entry_points.reason: DSpark-only (see ds4_gpu_device_cache_support_tensors). Unreached by a plain TP session.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_rope_tail_decode_rows_tensor
entry_points.reason: Only called from metal_graph_encode_qkv_session_batch (ds4.c) -- session batching is out of scope for this PRD. Single-stream decode applies RoPE via the already-real, non-TP-specific ds4_gpu_rope_tail_tensor instead.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_routed_moe_owned_packed_combine_tensor
entry_points.reason: Gated on g->cuda_tp_ep_pack_exact, which metal_graph_cuda_tp_ep_pack_exact_requested() forces false on ROCm builds -- the packed-4-slot layout is a CUDA-only perf optimization over the already-real plain 6-slot owned combine (ds4_gpu_routed_moe_owned_slots_combine_tensor).

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_shared_down_hc_expand_add_q8_0_tensor
entry_points.reason: Decode-only; needs fuse_shared_down_hc, which requires g->tp_world < 2 -- unreachable under any TP session.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_shared_down_hc_expand_owned_q8_0_tensor
entry_points.reason: Decode-only; needs cuda_tp_ep_fused_hc_reduce, which ds4.c ties to cuda_tp_ep_pack_exact -- forced false for ROCm. Confirmed unreachable.

entry_points.name: ds4_gpu_tp_batch_gate_encode
entry_points.reason: All ds4.c call sites for the five TP Gate Synchronisation entries are gated by g->tp_world == 2, set only inside ds4_engine_tp_bind, which hard-refuses off-Metal. These belong to the Metal two-machine --tensor-parallel --role gate protocol (ds4_tp.c), a different mechanism from --cuda-tensor-parallel's single-process design. Structurally unreachable dead code under ROCm; documented per issue 04's explicit finding and handoff to issue 08.
entry_points.target_slice: 04-tp-plumbing-no-crash.md (reachability documented under issue 08 per issue 04's explicit handoff)
